id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

header.description:
The header for the page. Includes things like tabs, title, etc.

NOTE: If {@link UiSdlTabPanel} is used, it should be used in {@link #header}, and {@link #children} should remain empty

gridStyle.description:
The style for the grid aspect of the layout.
FIXED layout will take up a minimum of a fixed amount of space centered
in the middle of the content area. Amount based on fixedSize.
FLUID layout will fill content area.

fixedSize.description:
The size to be used as the minimum width for the FIXED gridStyle.
MEDIUM: 1024px, LARGE: 1440px, XLARGE: 1920px

children.description:
The children components to be displayed in the content area of the layout.
Must be UiSdlGridContainer, so they adhere to the grid system.

NOTE: If {@link UiSdlTabPanel} is used, it should be used in {@link #header}, and {@link #children} should remain empty.

display.description: The direction children components should be displayed in.

gutter.description: Whether or not there should be spacing between children components.

pagePadding.description:
Whether or not we should include padding around the sides of the content area.
{@link #header} is not affected by this padding.

detachedFields.description:
This field is meant to place components that will be placed "outside" of the grid system
i.e. {@link UiSdlModal} {@link UiSdlMultiStepModal} {@link UiSdlSidePanel} and {@link UiSdlMessageContainer}

navMenu.description: The component to be rendered in `#nav-menu`.

highlightBorders.description: Indicates whether or not to highlight the grid layout borders.
